---
title: "Tools"
toc: false
---

Software that can be used directly, independent of any one analysis.

| Tool | What it does | Use it |
|---|---|---|
| VennCompare | Compare 2–7 sets in the browser: Venn, UpSet, pairwise similarity heatmap, exact overlap p-values with BH adjustment, set algebra, element search, R code export, session save/load. | [App](https://somatogenomics.github.io/venn-compare/) · [Source](https://github.com/Somatogenomics/venn-compare) |
| tauspec | R package: tau, TSI, Gini and entropy specificity per gene across tissues or stages; flag-and-retain low-expression handling; R API, config-driven CLI, Shiny app. | [Project page](projects/tauspec.qmd) · [Source](https://github.com/Somatogenomics/tauspec) |
| poolAD | R package: parse pool-seq AD fields as character then split (no fread auto-conversion), compute pooling-aware allele-frequency statistics, run from the command line through Snakemake. | [Project page](projects/poolad.qmd) |

: {.striped .hover}
